talents.name: Air of Authority
talents.benefit: The Explorer was born to command, either motivating or terrifying those under his charge.

talents.name: Ambidextrous
talents.benefit: This Talent does not represent true ambidexterity so much as sufficient training with both hands to make the distinction moot.

talents.name: Armour of Contempt
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s hatred of all the impure armours his soul against malign influenc .

talents.name: Assassin Strike
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s natural agility and graceful martial forms turn him into a dervish of death on the battlefield.

talents.name: Autosanguine
talents.benefit: The ancient and blessed technology of the Mechanicus or some corrupt xeno tech flows through the Explorer’s blood.

talents.name: Basic Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The Explorer has received Basic Weapon Training in a group of weapons, and can use them without penalty.

talents.name: Bastion of Iron Will
talents.prerequisites: Psy Rating, Strong Minded, Will Power 40
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s sheer willpower and psychic focus have become one and the same over years of practice and training, such that their combined use is second nature.

talents.name: Battle Rage
talents.benefit: Long experience and indomitable will have allowed the Explorer to master the beast within, directing its rage while keeping a level head.

talents.name: Berserk Charge
talents.benefit: The Explorer has learned to put the whole force of his momentum behind his weapon blows.

talents.name: Binary Chatter
talents.benefit: The Explorer has optimised his use of Techna-Lingua for controlling servitors.

talents.name: Blademaster
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s mastery of bladed weapons and their martial disciplines has no peer.

talents.name: Blessed Radiance
talents.prerequisites: Purge the Unclean, Divine Ministration, the Emperor Protects, or Wrath of the Righteous
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s holiness shines out, allowing all to see the truth of their own souls.

talents.name: Blind Fighting
talents.benefit: Years of practice and development of the Explorer’s other senses allows him to fight in close combat without the benefit of sight.

talents.name: Bloodtracker
talents.benefit: The Explorer is an experienced and cunning bounty hunter who commands the highest price for bringing in a quarry in dead or alive.

talents.name: Bulging Biceps
talents.benefit: Whereas a weaker man would be sent flying when using powerful weapons, the Explorer’s strong physique allows him to remain standing.

talents.name: Catfall
talents.benefit: Gymnastic ability and natural balance enables the Explorer to fall far greater distances without harm than the common man.

talents.name: Chem Geld
talents.benefit: Either chemical and surgical treatments or sheer will has rendered the Explorer immune to most mundane temptations.

talents.name: Cleanse and Purify
talents.benefit: The Explorer can control the flow of molten promethium like no other, manipulating flame like an old accomplice.

talents.name: Combat Formation
talents.benefit: The Explorer has directed his comrades to be prepared for danger, planning out their actions for many contingencies if attacked.

talents.name: Combat Master
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s weapon seems to be everywhere at once, keeping many more opponents at bay in close combat than even skilled fighter .

talents.name: Combat Sense
talents.benefit: The Explorer has the ability to consciously recognise the proddings of his subconscious as it reacts to his preternaturally sharp senses, giving the character an edge that mere speed cannot match.

talents.name: Concealed Cavity
talents.benefit: The character’s flesh or augmetics conceals a small compartment.

talents.name: Counter Attack
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s lightning ripostes are things of beauty—if they were slow enough to be seen.

talents.name: Crack Shot
talents.benefit: The Explorer can place his shots where they will inflict more harm: at creases, gaps, or joints in armour.

talents.name: Crippling Strike
talents.benefit: The Explorer can land blows precisely where they will inflict the most harm, cutting into seams or hammering at weak points.

talents.name: Crushing Blow
talents.benefit: The Explorer has the ability to focus his entire body into close combat attacks., adding +2 to damage

talents.name: Dark Soul
talents.benefit: Prolonged exposure to darkness has acted as an inoculation against all that is foul, granting the Explorer resilience against corruption.

talents.name: Deadeye Shot
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s rock-steady hand and hawk-like eyesight make him a dreaded marksman.

talents.name: Decadence
talents.benefit: Through conditioning or long years of abuse, the Explorer has built up a tolerance to many inebriants, drugs, and chemicals.

talents.name: Die Hard
talents.benefit: Through either willpower or sheer stubbornness, the Explorer refuses to cross into shadow.

talents.name: Disarm
talents.benefit: The Explorer can wrest weapons from an opponent’s hands through practiced technique or brute force.

talents.name: Disturbing Voice
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s voice has particularly baleful or menacing qualities, causing others to quail before it.

talents.name: Divine Ministration
talents.benefit: The Explorer is a vessel for the Emperor’s mercy and beneficence, his faith in his divinity can heal where no mere skill can.

talents.name: Double Team
talents.benefit: The Explorer has the experience from many mass combats and swirling melees under his belt.

talents.name: Dual Shot
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s skill with guns is such that he can target two shots on exactly the same point.

talents.name: Dual Strike
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s skill with melee weapons can place two blows together to maximise damage.

talents.name: Duty Unto Death
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s will or faith can sustain him when his flesh is weak.

talents.name: Electrical Succour
talents.benefit: The Explorer can channel the sacred flow of energy from his Potentia Coil or other energy source to replenish his flesh.

talents.name: Electro Graft Use
talents.benefit: The Explorer may use his Electro Graft to access data ports and commune with machine spirits.

talents.name: Enemy
talents.benefit: The opposite of Good Reputation on page 99, the Explorer is particularly despised by a specific social group or organisation.

talents.name: Energy Cache
talents.benefit: The Explorer has learned to focus the power stored within his Potentia Coil with greater efficienc .

talents.name: Enhanced Bionic Frame
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s already impressive bionic body structure is steadied by a gyro-array guided by a targeting system linked to the machine-spirit.

talents.name: Exotic Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The Explorer has received Exotic Weapon Training in a single Exotic Weapon, and can use it without penalty.

talents.name: Favoured by the Warp
talents.benefit: Whenever a Focus Power Test results in Psychic Phenomena, the Explorer may roll twice on that table and take the more favourable result.

talents.name: Fearless
talents.benefit: Through hard experience with horrifying situations, fear no longer commands the Explorer’s actions.

talents.name: Feedback Screech
talents.benefit: The Explorer can haywire his vox synthesisers, causing a hideous blast of noise that shocks and distracts others.

talents.name: Ferric Lure
talents.benefit: The Explorer can cause an unsecured metal object within his field of vision to fly into his hand.

talents.name: Ferric Summons
talents.benefit: The Explorer can call an unsecured metal object to his hand as with Ferric Lure.

talents.name: Flame Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The sight of flaming streams of promethium brings joy to the Explorer’s heart and dread to his foes.

talents.name: Foresight
talents.benefit: Logic and analysis do for the Explorer what Tarot and the bones claim to do for the superstitious masses.

talents.name: Frenzy
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s temper and passion boil just below the surface of his psyche, mostly held in check by his rational mind, but easily released when needed.

talents.name: Furious Assault
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s speed and martial prowess allow him to land several blows where lesser combatants land one.

talents.name: Good Reputation
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s reputation precedes him in interactions with a specific group or organisation, opening doors that might otherwise remain closed.

talents.name: Guardian
talents.benefit: Years of serving as a bodyguard allow the Explorer to put himself in the line of fire, or to take a murderous attack that was intended for another.

talents.name: Gun Blessing
talents.benefit: Using the Explorer’s sacred ability to subtly affect ferrous materials, he can un-jam a number of weapons equal to his Intelligence Bonus, so long as they are within a 10-metre radius.

talents.name: Gunslinger
talents.benefit: The Explorer has trained with pistols for so long that they are like extensions of his own body, barely requiring conscious thought to aim and fi e.

talents.name: Hard Bargain
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s shrewd negotiations and bartering skills are without peer, and he has a knack for seeing opportunities for profit where others see nothing.

talents.name: Hard Target
talents.benefit: Light on his feet, the Explorer dodges and weaves as he moves, skills learned from long years in the line of fi e.

talents.name: Hardy
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s constitution rebounds quickly from shock or injury.

talents.name: Hatred
talents.benefit: A group, organisation or race has wronged the Explorer in the past, fuelling this animosity.

talents.name: Heavy Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The Explorer can employ some of the most devastating weapons of the battlefield, able to vaporise single foes and strike fear into the machine spirits of vehicles everywhere.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
talents.benefit: Either genetics or augmetics have made one of the Explorer’s senses superior to others.

talents.name: Hip Shooting
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s prowess with ranged weapons is such that he can still fi e accurately without using the sights.

talents.name: Hotshot Pilot
talents.benefit: The Explorer can pilot vehicles as if they were extensions of his own body.

talents.name: Infused Knowledge
talents.benefit: The Explorer has been infused with a great wealth of lore and knowledge, either through punishing noetic techniques or by arcane methods kept secret by the guardians of technology and knowledge.

talents.name: Improved Warp Sense
talents.benefit: The Explorer can now see the warp and physical universe side by side, no longer taking any concentration on his part.

talents.name: Independent Targeting
talents.benefit: The Explorer has developed his peripheral vision and situational awareness to a point where he can fire in two directions within a split second.

talents.name: Into the Jaws of Hell
talents.benefit: The Explorer inspires loyalty and devotion in his followers such that they would follow him into the warp or on a boarding action against xeno corsairs.

talents.name: Inspire Wrath
talents.benefit: The Explorer knows just the turn of phrase that incites individuals or groups to rage against others.

talents.name: Iron Discipline
talents.benefit: Iron sharpens iron.

talents.name: Iron Jaw
talents.benefit: The Explorer has taken blows from Orks and given back as good as he got.

talents.name: Jaded
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s wide travels have shown both wonders and horrors beyond the ken of most.

talents.name: Leap Up
talents.benefit: A combination of athletic ability and speed allow the Explorer to spring to his feet in virtually any circumstance.

talents.name: Last Man Standing
talents.benefit: The Explorer has developed a sixth sense about hails of gunfi e, allowing him to sense gaps and pauses in the lethal rain.

talents.name: Light Sleeper
talents.benefit: The slightest change in conditions or disturbance brings the Explorer from sleep to full awareness, remaining alert even in slumber.

talents.name: Lightning Attack
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s speed with weapons is legendary, allowing him to launch flurries of attacks.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.benefit: The Explorer always expects trouble, even in the most innocuous situations, allowing him to act quickly when needed.

talents.name: Litany of Hate
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s belief in the righteousness of his hatred is so ingrained that he can rouse others to join his crusade.

talents.name: Logis Implant
talents.benefit: The Explorer may use analytical circuits to calculate trajectory and reactions to a preternatural extent.

talents.name: Luminen Blast
talents.benefit: The Omnissiah has blessed the Explorer with augmetic conduits that parallel the bones of his arms.

talents.name: Luminen Charge
talents.benefit: The Explorer has mastered the union between his holy mechanical elements and his mortal flesh, allowing the former to power the latter.

talents.name: Luminen Shock
talents.benefit: The power of the Explorer’s Potentia Coil flows through a network of inductors within his flesh, allowing him to channel this energy into his blows.

talents.name: Machinator Array
talents.benefit: The Explorer has returned to the crèches of the Mechanicus so they can bring him closer to the most holy of forms, adding an extensive machinator array to his existing augmetics.

talents.name: Maglev Grace
talents.benefit: The Explorer stitches augmetic coils throughout the systems or flesh of his legs, granting him the ability to float a short distance above the ground.

talents.name: Maglev Transcendence
talents.benefit: The Explorer has proven his devotion to the Machine God by lacing augmetic coils through every portion of his body.

talents.name: Marksman
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s steady hand and eagle eye allows him to keep crosshairs steady on any target, regardless of range.

talents.name: Master & Commander
talents.benefit: There can be only one commander of a vessel, and the Explorer’s guiding hand, stern judgment, and sage leadership have captained his crew through countless conflict .

talents.name: Master Chirurgeon
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s advanced medical skills enable him knit flesh with deft mastery.

talents.name: Master Enginseer
talents.benefit: Implants The Explorer’s knowledge of starships and their machine spirits surpasses all his planet-bound brethren.

talents.name: Master Orator
talents.benefit: The Explorer has learned the techniques required to influence large audiences.

talents.name: Mechadendrite Use
talents.benefit: Though there are many different types of Mechadendrite, this Talent divides them into two broad categories: Weapon: Mechadendrites of this type end in either ranged or close combat weapons, and have the supplemental support and strength necessary for combat.

talents.name: Melee Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The Explorer has trained extensively with hand-to-hand weaponry, becoming proficient in the use of virtually all hand-held close combat arms.

talents.name: Mighty Shot
talents.benefit: The Explorer knows the weak points in every armour and material, and has the skill to place shots exactly where they will do the most damage.

talents.name: Mimic
talents.benefit: Vox synthesisers, training or innate abilities allow the Explorer to accurately mimic the voice of another.

talents.name: Navigator
talents.benefit: The Explorer was born with the Navigator gene, either of the Navis Nobilite or in the shadowed ranks of the unlicensed.

talents.name: Navigator Power
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s trainers or natural ability allows use of an additional Navigator Power.

talents.name: Nerves of Steel
talents.benefit: Long years on the battlefield enable the Explorer to remain calm as fi e impacts all around.

talents.name: Orthoproxy
talents.benefit: A liturgical circuit has been implanted within the Explorer’s skull, allowing him to focus on the prayers recited by the proxy unit when his mental fortitude is in peril.

talents.name: Paranoia
talents.benefit: The Explorer knows that danger lurks behind every corner and knows the galaxy will hit him as soon as he lets his guard down.

talents.name: Peer
talents.benefit: The Explorer is adept at dealing with a particular social group or organisation.

talents.name: Pistol Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The Explorer has practiced with nearly every single-handed ranged weapon within the confines of the Imperium, and no small number without.

talents.name: Polyglot
talents.benefit: The Explorer has an innate ability to derive meaning from unknown languages and make himself understood using this intuitive grasp.

talents.name: Precise Blow
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s eye, hand, and weapon act seamlessly together, placing blows exactly where the attacker intends.

talents.name: Prosanguine
talents.benefit: Through the Explorer’s iron will or via appeals to the Omnissiah, he is able to speed the function of his Autosanguinators.

talents.name: Psy Rating
talents.benefit: The Explorer is a psyker, and his power in game terms is rated on a scale of 1 to 10, where Psy Rating 1 is the lowest to warrant the attentions of the Scholastia Psykana and the Black Ships, and a rating of 10 represents one of the most powerful of the entire human sphere.

talents.name: Psychic Discipline
talents.benefit: The Explorer gains access to a new Psychic Discipline, and may select techniques from this new field of study as his abilities increase.

talents.name: Psychic Technique
talents.benefit: Either through training or natural development, the Explorer has learned an additional Psychic Technique.

talents.name: Pure Faith
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s faith in the God Emperor of Mankind, his divine power and grace, is total and complete.

talents.name: Purge the Unclean
talents.benefit: The Explorer can focus his faith through words, gestures, and force of will such that a daemon may be cowed or cast out by the power of the Emperor.

talents.name: Quick Draw
talents.benefit: The Explorer has practised so frequently with his weapons that they practically leap into his hands, ready for action.

talents.name: Rapid Reaction
talents.benefit: The Explorer has honed his reactions to a razor’s edge, allowing him to act while most stand dumbfounded.

talents.name: Rapid Reload
talents.benefit: The practice bays aboard the Explorer’s vessel are like a second home, and he has reloaded countless magazines or power cells for his weapons until he can replace them with his eyes closed.

talents.name: Renowned Warrant
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s Warrant of Trade is ancient and hallowed, signed before the Imperium knew of the Expanse, and garners the respect of merchants and officials alike.

talents.name: Resistance
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s background, experience, training, exposure, or plain stubbornness has inured him to a particular type of hardship.

talents.name: Rite of Awe
talents.benefit: The Omnissiah has augmetically blessed the Explorer’s voice box, allowing him to recite infrasonic liturgies that trigger awe and fear.

talents.name: Rite of Fear
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s infrasonic dirges cause terror in the weak.

talents.name: Rite of Pure Thought
talents.benefit: The Explorer has replaced the creative half of his brain with sacred cranial circuitry.

talents.name: Rite of Sanctioning
talents.benefit: The Explorer has been brought before the Emperor and has received a miniscule fraction of His awesome strength, making the character far more resistant to the predations of the Warp.

talents.name: Rival
talents.benefit: particular social group or organisation.

talents.name: Sharpshooter
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s steady hand and eagle eye allow him to place shots exactly where he wants.

talents.name: Sound Constitution
talents.benefit: The Explorer gains an additional Wound.

talents.name: Sprint
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s fleet feet can propel him faster than his comrades.

talents.name: Step Aside
talents.benefit: The Explorer can sway his body out of the path of an attack, causing it to pass through thin air.

talents.name: Strong Minded
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s mind acts as a fortress against psychic attacks.

talents.name: Sure Strike
talents.benefit: The Explorer can direct his blows far better than most, giving him some control over where they land.

talents.name: Swift Attack
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s speed and martial ability allow him to land flurries of blows.

talents.name: Talented
talents.benefit: The Explorer has a natural affinity for a particular Skill.

talents.name: Technical Knock
talents.benefit: Either through the ease of long practice, or the proper ritual to appease a weapon’s machine spirit, the Explorer can clear stoppages in weapons.

talents.name: The Emperor Protects
talents.benefit: The power of the Emperor flows through the Explorer, protecting the faithful and emboldening them to heroism in the face of terrible things.

talents.name: Thrown Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s mastery of the balance, spin, and weight of thrown weapons makes him a formidable foe at any distance, even if only armed with a knife.

talents.name: Total Recall
talents.benefit: Mental conditioning or augmetics enable the Explorer to record and recall great amounts of information, effectively granting him a perfect memory.

talents.name: True Grit
talents.benefit: The Explorer is able to shrug off wounds that would fell lesser men.

talents.name: Two-Weapon Wielder
talents.prerequisites: Ballistic Skill 35 or Weapon Skill 35, Agility 35
talents.benefit: Years of training allow the Explorer to use a weapon in each hand when needed.

talents.name: Unarmed Master
talents.benefit: Warrior The Explorer has developed unequalled mastery of unarmed combat techniques.

talents.name: Unarmed Warrior
talents.benefit: Due to extensive training in unarmed combat, the Explorer’s unarmed combat attacks do 1d10- 3 (+SB) Damage instead of 1d5-3.

talents.name: Unremarkable
talents.benefit: The Explorer has mastered the art of blending into any crowd by adopting its mannerisms.

talents.name: Unshakable Faith
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s confidence in the Emperor and his abilities is so strong that he can face any danger.

talents.name: Void Tactician
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s ability to conceptualise three-dimensional space gives him an advantage in starship combat, granting a +10 bonus to Ballistic Skill Tests made to fi e a starship’s guns in combat.

talents.name: Wall of Steel
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s skill with blades is so profound that the merest hint of attack allows him to assume a defensive position.

talents.name: Warp Affinity
talents.benefit: The Explorer has a special connection to the warp, allowing him to occasionally sense and avoid its less desirable effects as he channels its power.

talents.name: Warp Conduit
talents.benefit: The sheer power of the Explorer’s mind allows him to channel much more warp energy than his peers.

talents.name: Warp Sense
talents.prerequisites: Navigator or Psy Rating, Psyniscience Skill, Perception 30
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s senses have evolved to perceive the warp in parallel with the physical world, though it requires some concentration to do so.

talents.name: Whispers
talents.benefit: Such is the Explorer’s reputation for having ears everywhere aboard the ship and a fine y tuned network of invisible informants that the crew no longer even bothers to keep secrets from him.

talents.name: Wrath of the Righteous
talents.benefit: The Explorer is a killing angel, and he visits the Emperor’s righteous fury on those who deny His dominion over the stars, or who profane that which is sacred.

talents.name: Maglev Transcendence

talents.name: Marksman
talents.benefit: The character’s steady hand and eagle eye allows him to keep crosshairs steady on any target, regardless of range.

talents.name: Lasgun Barrage

talents.name: Leap Up
talents.benefit: A combination of athletic ability and speed allow the character to spring to their feet in virtually any circumstance.

talents.name: Light Sleeper
talents.benefit: The slightest change in conditions or disturbance brings the character from sleep to full awareness, remaining alert even in slumber.

talents.name: Lightning Attack

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes

talents.name: Meditation

talents.name: Mighty Shot

talents.name: Mimic
talents.benefit: Vox synthesisers, training, or innate abilities allow the character to accurately mimic the voice of another.

talents.name: Master Chirurgeon
talents.benefit: The character’s advanced medical skills enable him to knit ﬂesh with deft mastery.

talents.name: Master Enginseer
talents.benefit: The character’s knowledge of engines and their machine spirits surpasses all but the most venerable servants of the Machine-God.

talents.name: Master Orator
talents.benefit: The character has learned the techniques required to inﬂuence large audiences.

talents.name: Mastery
talents.benefit: The character has become a consummate master of a single Skill and can perform feats with it that would bafﬂe lesser men.

talents.name: Never Die
talents.benefit: The character’s will or devotion to the Emperor can sustain him when his mortal body fails him.

talents.benefit: Either part of the character’s brain has been removed or an inhibitor such as a reason inhibitor circuit has been implanted within the character’s skull, allowing him to ignore the mental strain that would affect a more “complete” person.

talents.name: Paranoia
talents.benefit: The character knows that danger lurks behind every corner and that the galaxy will hit him as soon as he lets his guard down.

talents.name: Peer
talents.benefit: The character knows how to deal with a particular social group or organisation.

talents.name: Munitorum Influence
talents.benefit: Whether through contacts in the Departmento Munitorum or simple fame amongst the ranks of the Imperial Guard, the character has an easier time acquiring equipment for his Squad.

talents.name: Nerves of Steel
talents.benefit: Long years on the battleﬁeld enable the character to remain calm as ﬁre impacts all around them.

talents.name: Quick Draw
talents.benefit: The character has practised so frequently with his weapons that they practically leap into his hands in response to a simple thought.

talents.name: Radiant Presence
talents.benefit: There is something strong and inspiring about the character, the way he holds himself and the look in his eyes, that puts people at ease, ﬁlling them with conﬁdence.

talents.name: Rapid Reaction
talents.benefit: The character has honed his reactions to a razor’s edge, allowing him to act while most stand dumbfounded.

talents.name: Rapid Reload
talents.benefit: The ﬁring ranges and weapon drill chambers are the character’s constant abode, and hours of reloading countless magazines or power cells means that he can replace them without looking and without thinking.

talents.name: Resistance
talents.benefit: The character’s background, experience, training, exposure or plain stubbornness has developed a resistance within him.

talents.name: Polyglot
talents.benefit: The character has an innate ability to derive meaning from unknown languages and can make himself understood using this intuitive grasp.

talents.name: Precise Blow

talents.name: Preternatural Speed

talents.name: Prosanguine

talents.name: Psychic Power

talents.name: Step Aside

talents.name: Storm of Iron

talents.name: Street Fighting

talents.name: Sure Strike
talents.benefit: The character’s eyes, hand, and weapon act seamlessly together, placing his blows where he intends.

talents.name: Swift Attack
talents.benefit: The character’s ability with weapons is legendary, allowing him to attack with amazing speed in melee.

talents.name: Sharpshooter
talents.benefit: The character’s steady hand and eagle eye allow him to place shots or strikes exactly where he wants.

talents.name: Sound Constitution
talents.benefit: The character gains an additional Wound.

talents.name: Sprint
talents.benefit: The character can move at great speeds.

talents.name: Strong Minded
talents.benefit: The character’s mind acts as a fortress against psychic attacks.

talents.name: Total Recall
talents.benefit: Mental conditioning or cranial augmentation enables the character to record and recall great amounts of information, effectively granting them a perfect memory.

talents.name: True Grit
talents.benefit: The character is able to shrug off wounds that would fell lesser men.

talents.name: Two-Weapon Wielder

talents.benefit: Intensive training allows the character to use a weapon in each hand when needed.

talents.name: Unarmed Master
talents.benefit: The character possesses unparalleled mastery of unarmed combat.

talents.name: Takedown
talents.benefit: As a Half Action, or when making a Charge Action, the character may declare that he is attempting a takedown against an opponent in melee combat.

talents.name: Target Selection
talents.benefit: The character’s dread gaze marks out his chosen victim and not even the riotous confusion of close combat interferes.

talents.name: Technical Knock
talents.benefit: Either through the ease of long practice, or the proper ritual to appease a weapon’s machine spirit, the character can clear stoppages with a simple knock or solid smack of his hand to a weapon.

talents.name: Thunder Charge
talents.benefit: The character charges into combat using his body as an additional weapon to push foes away or to the ground.

talents.name: Warp Sense
talents.benefit: The character’s senses have evolved to perceive the warp in parallel with the physical world.

talents.name: Weapon-Tech
talents.benefit: The character has developed an extensive understanding of advanced technological weapons and their functions, opening them up and learning what makes them tick, hum, or click.

talents.name: Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The character can use all weapons with Class: Pistol, Basic, Melee, Throwing, and Vehicle within the group he has selected with this Talent.

talents.name: Whirlwind of Death
talents.benefit: When facing massed opponents in combat, the character becomes a whirlwind of death, moving, hacking, gutting, and beheading with ceaseless fury.

talents.name: Unarmed Warrior

talents.name: Unremarkable
talents.benefit: Something about the character’s face just doesn’t stick in people’s memories.

talents.name: Unshakeable Faith
talents.benefit: The Guardsman’s faith in the Emperor and his abilities is so strong that he can face any danger.

talents.name: Warp Conduit
talents.benefit: The sheer power of the character’s mind allows the character to channel vast amounts of Warp Energy when he chooses.

talents.name: Warp Lock

talents.name: Storm of Iron
talents.benefit: When facing the massed enemies, the Heretic lays down a storm of ﬁ repower that even the most foolhardy cannot push through.

talents.name: Street Fighting
talents.benefit: The character is adept at close and dirty ﬁ ghting, favouring small weapons or even his bare hands to take down his foes.

talents.name: Strong Minded
talents.benefit: The Heretic’s mind acts as a fortress against psychic attacks.

talents.name: Sure Strike
talents.benefit: The character’s eye, hand and weapon act seamlessly together, placing the characters blows where he intends.

talents.name: Swift Attack
talents.benefit: The character’s speed with weapons is legendary, allowing him to launch ﬂ urries of attacks in melee.

talents.name: Takedown
talents.benefit: As a Half Action or when making a Charge Attack the character may declare that he is attempting a takedown against an opponent in melee combat.

talents.name: Target Selection
talents.benefit: The character’s dread gaze marks out his chosen victim, and not even the riotous confusion of close combat interferes.

talents.name: Technical Knock
talents.benefit: Either through the ease of long practice, or the proper ritual to appease a weapon’s machine spirit, the character can clear stoppages with a simple knock or solid smack of his hand to a weapon.

talents.name: Thunder Charge
talents.benefit: The character charges into combat using his body as an additional weapon to push foes away or to the ground.

talents.name: Total Recall
talents.benefit: Mental conditioning or mental augmentation enables the character to record and recall great amounts of information, effectively granting him a perfect memory.

talents.name: True Grit
talents.benefit: The character is able to shrug off wounds that would fell lesser men.

talents.name: Two-Weapon Wielder
talents.benefit: Intensive training allows the character to use a weapon in each hand when needed.

talents.name: Unarmed Master
talents.benefit: The Heretic possesses unparalleled mastery of unarmed combat.

talents.name: Unarmed Warrior
talents.benefit: Due to extensive training in techniques of unarmed combat the character has gained the Natural Weapon Trait (see page 142) improving all his unarmed attacks from 1d5-3 to 1d10 Primitive (7) and meaning he counts as armed even when facing opponents with weapons while bare handed.

talents.name: Unholy Devotion
talents.benefit: The character’s Minions are fanatically devoted to him and would gladly die in his name.

talents.name: Unremarkable
talents.benefit: Something about the character’s face just doesn’t stick in people’s memories.

talents.name: Unshakeable Will
talents.benefit: The character’s faith in the gods and in himself are so strong that he can face any danger with a sneer and a ready insult.

talents.name: War Cry
talents.benefit: There is something supernatural about the character’s bellowing voice, its tones ﬁ lled with the wails of daemons and its words repellent to the mind, causing terror in the weak.

talents.name: Warp Conduit
talents.benefit: The sheer power of the character’s mind allows the character to channel vast amounts of Warp Energy when he chooses to exert himself.

talents.name: Warp Lock
talents.benefit: The character has learned to swiftly cut himself off from the warp to protect himself from harm and cocoon his mind against the worst of its effects.

talents.name: Warp Sense
talents.benefit: The character’s senses have evolved to perceive the Warp in parallel with the physical world.

talents.name: Weapon-Tech
talents.benefit: The character has developed an extensive understanding of advanced technological weapons and their functions, opening them up and learning what makes them tick, hum or click.

talents.name: Weapon Training
talents.benefit: The character can employ some of the most devastating weapons of the battleﬁ eld.

talents.name: Whirlwind of Death
talents.benefit: When facing massed opponents in combat the character becomes a whirlwind of death, moving, hacking, gutting, and beheading with ceaseless fury.

talents.name: Wisdom of the Ancients
talents.benefit: The character has survived many wars, seen much and been favoured with the experience of countless ancient warriors during his life.

talents.name: Berserker
talents.benefit: The character fights with an unrestrained fury that only the death of all those who stand against him can sate.

talents.name: Blade Dancer
talents.prerequisites: Agility 40, Acrobatics skill, Weapon Skill 40, Melee Weapon Training (any)
talents.benefit: The character fights with a deadly, athletic grace; flipping over opponents, deflecting blows, repositioning and killing with swift, precise cuts.

talents.name: Call of Iron
talents.benefit: The character may lift or move any unsecured metal objects weighing up to 2 kilograms per point of Willpower Bonus within a 40m range.

talents.name: Conditioned Intellect
talents.benefit: By spending ten minutes studying or analysing a problem, the character gains a +10 bonus to his next Intelligence Test.

talents.name: Death Blow
talents.benefit: The character can kill with a single, immensely powerful blow to the enemy’s most vulnerable points.

talents.name: Electro Illumination
talents.benefit: The Tech-Priest has mastered the electricity that flows through his biological and mechanical components, allowing him to use it as a deadly weapon or to feed the hungry circuits of machines.

talents.name: Exemplar of Metal
talents.benefit: This Talent completely exchanges its benefits for those of the Talents it replaces (including the Characteristic increases from Machinator Array and the Armour increases from The Flesh Is Weak).

talents.name: Gravitic Levitation
talents.benefit: The character has mastered the secrets of anti-Gravitic field generation.

talents.name: Gunfighter Saint
talents.prerequisites: Ballistic Skill 40, Agility 40, Pistol Weapon Training (any)
talents.benefit: The character is a gunfighter of terrifying skill; in his hands, pistols seem to have a will of their own, a will that wants only to bring death to the living.

talents.name: Heroic Leadership
talents.benefit: The character’s presence, deeds, and words inspire those around him to face the darkness without fear and perform deeds equal to the greatest heroes of the Imperium.

talents.name: Heightened Reactions
talents.benefit: The character is constantly attuned to danger and reacts faster than sight when under pressure.

talents.name: Indomitable Fortitude
talents.benefit: The character’s unbending will, combined with a constitution like tempered steel, allows him to disregard injuries that would cripple others.

talents.name: Machine Spirit Empathy
talents.benefit: Intelligence 30, Fellowship 30, Mechanicus Implants

talents.name: Mental Aegis
talents.benefit: Mental Fortress, Resistance (Psychics), Strong Minded

talents.name: Peerless Marksman
talents.benefit: The character’s marksmanship is so developed that he can kill a distant target with a single shot.

talents.name: Purity of the Machine
talents.benefit: The character has been freed of the weakness of his remaining flesh’s desires and physical vulnerability.

talents.name: Storm of Blows
talents.benefit: The character becomes a storm of violence and death in battle, raining blows on his enemies with remorseless fury.

talents.name: Soul of Stone
talents.benefit: The character’s soul is as cold and unfeeling as stone.

talents.name: Transcendent Hate
talents.benefit: The character’s hate for his enemies is so profound that it has transcended single groups and is projected onto any who stand against him.

talents.name: Unarmed Ascendant Mastery
talents.benefit: The character has mastered techniques of unarmed combat to such a level that he is as lethal unarmed as armed; able to strike with hammer-like force, knock out opponents with a well-placed blow, or take an enemy’s weapon from his hands at will.

talents.name: Unassailable Grace
talents.benefit: The character reacts to attacks so quickly and fluidly that he seems to dance through blade swings and gunfire, knocking bullets from the air and pivoting aside from danger.

talents.name: Voice of the Omnissiah
talents.benefit: The character has total control over the emissions from his vox unit implants enabling him to produce blurts of disturbing binary code, imitate others voices, or turn his own synthesised voice into a fearful distorted rasp.

talents.name: Good Reputation
talents.benefit: Government, Hivers, Imperial Guard, Imperial Navy, Inquisition, Middle Class, Military, Navigators, Nobility, Officio Assassinorum, PDF, Pilgrims, Planet (specific), Recidivist Organisation (specific), Rogue Trader, Underworld, Void Born, Workers You know how to deal with a particular social group or

talents.name: Peer
talents.benefit: The savants, archivists and sages who lurk in libraries and data vaults across the Imperium Death Worlders Those born and raised on worlds whose environments are hostile to life and on which human settlement is a miracle Feral Worlders

talents.name: Ascended Psychic Power
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent may select one Ascended Psychic Power.

talents.name: Combat Formation
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent has directed his comrades to be prepared for danger, planning out their actions for many contingencies if attacked.

talents.name: Combat Sense
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent has the ability to consciously recognise the proddings of his subconscious as it reacts to his preternaturally sharp senses, giving him an edge that mere speed cannot match.

talents.name: Enhanced Bionic Frame
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent’s already impressive bionic body structure is steadied by a gyro-array guided by a targeting system linked to the machine-spirit.

talents.name: Favoured by Fate
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent is particularly blessed by the Emperor’s Grace, or perhaps simply destined for greatness.

talents.name: Guardian
talents.benefit: Years of serving as a bodyguard allows the Throne Agent to put himself in the line of fire, or to take a murderous attack that was intended for another.

talents.name: Infused Knowledge
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent has been infused with a great wealth of lore and knowledge, either through punishing noetic techniques or by arcane methods kept secret by the guardians of technology and knowledge.

talents.name: Machinator Array
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent has returned to the crèches of the Mechanicus so they can bring him closer to the most holy of forms, adding an extensive machinator array to his existing augmetics.

talents.name: Mnemonic Purging
talents.benefit: The character has been conditioned and trained so that he is able to deliberately remove his memories.

talents.name: Perfect Shot
talents.benefit: Vindicare Assassins are renowned for their matchless skill as a sniper—slaying one target leads naturally to centring the next in the cross-hairs.

talents.name: Polyglot
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent has an innate ability to derive meaning from unknown languages and make himself understood using this intuitive grasp.

talents.name: Rite of Protection
talents.benefit: The character is able to deliberately induce a state of consciousness where he can function, but remembers nothing of what has passed after a certain time.

talents.name: Target Selection
talents.benefit: The character’s dread gaze marks out his chosen victim, and not even the riotous confusion of close combat interferes.

talents.name: The Emperor Protects
talents.benefit: The power of the Emperor flows through the Explorer, protecting the faithful and emboldening them to heroism in the face of terrible things.

talents.name: Unarmed Master
talents.benefit: The Throne Agent has developed unequalled mastery of unarmed combat techniques.

talents.name: Unarmed Warrior
talents.benefit: Due to extensive training in unarmed combat, the Throne Agent’s unarmed combat attacks do 1d10–3 (+SB) I Damage instead of 1d5–3.

talents.name: Purge the Unclean
talents.benefit: You can focus your faith through words, gestures and force of will, such that a Daemon may be cowed or cast out by the power of the Emperor.

talents.name: Divine Ministration
talents.benefit: You are a vessel for the Emperor’s mercy and beneficence, your skill and faith in His divinity can heal where no mere skill can.

talents.name: Wrath of the Righteous
talents.benefit: You are a killing angel and you visit the Emperor’s righteous fury on those who deny His dominion over the stars or those who profane that which is sacred.

talents.name: Blessed Radiance
talents.prerequisites: Purge the Unclean, Divine Ministration or Wrath of the Righteous
talents.benefit: Your holiness shines out, allowing all to see the truth of their own souls.

talents.name: Beast Hunter
talents.benefit: Many feral worlders were beast hunters long before they saw Imperial service.

talents.name: The Reaping
talents.benefit: The deadly fighting arts of the Moritat teach a special manoeuvre only made possible by their near preternatural skill with a blade, allowing one great devastating cut with which several opponents can be despatched in a great effusion of sacred blood.

sources.coverage: ok — 11 talents from Dark Heresy - The Radical's Handbook.md

talents.name: Daemonic Essence
talents.benefit: The daemon is bound to your flesh and being.

talents.name: Monster Beneath the Skin
talents.benefit: While the daemon within you reigns, the monster that is lurking beneath your skin and behind your eyes is visible to all: your body warps, phases and changes as you are flooded with raw daemonic power.

talents.name: Power of the Warp
talents.benefit: The power of the warp flows through you when the daemon within is unleashed, allowing you to violate reality with powerful sorceries and psychic power.

talents.name: Ruin Incarnate
talents.benefit: Note: This Talent is automatically gained when a character with the Daemon Vessel Elite Advance package reaches 91 Corruption Points.

talents.name: Sorcerer
talents.prerequisites: Intelligence 35+, Willpower 35+, Forbidden Lore (Demonology or Warp) +10
talents.benefit: The Acolyte may use the powers of sorcery to channel the warp through a combination of esoteric lore, skill and focused will.

talents.name: Master Sorcerer
talents.benefit: Forbidden Lore (Demonology or Warp) +20.

talents.name: Minor Arcana
talents.benefit: The sorcerer has acquired an additional Minor Arcana Power over the amount usually allowed; this must be learned or researched as normal.

talents.name: Major Arcana
talents.benefit: The sorcerer has acquired an additional Major Arcana Power over the amount usually allowed; this must be learned or researched as normal.

talents.name: Sublime Arts
talents.benefit: The sorcerer may use his powers without the usual need for obvious vocalisations, gestures, and the like, simply enacting the patterns needed mentally by sheer dint of concentration and unyielding mental strength.

talents.name: Fuelled by Flesh
talents.benefit: In manifesting their powers, many sorcerers practice some form of self-mutilation in order to further augment and empower their incantations with their own suffering and bodily sacrifice.

talents.name: Touched by the Fates
talents.benefit: free will; may not be applied to daemons and other non-living creatures.

sources.coverage: ok — 9 talents from Dark Heresy - Blood of Martyrs.md

talents.name: Chain Weapon Expert
talents.benefit: The character knows that fear is for the enemy, fear and wrath.

talents.name: Flame Weapon Expert
talents.benefit: When wielding a Flame Weapon, the character knows exactly when to release the trigger to avoid jamming the weapon or when to push its functions in the glorious name of the God-Emperor.

talents.name: Drill Instruction
talents.benefit: The character may bellow commands to all those in earshot.

talents.name: Litany of Battle
talents.benefit: The Battle Sister knows hundreds of litanies and always recites exactly the most appropriate verse in battle, bolstering her allies with the wisdom of saints.

talents.name: Tests of Faith
talents.benefit: The Battle Sister’s faith has been tested in the ﬁ res of combat and she has emerged with her faith tempered and sharpened.

talents.name: Miraculous Survival
talents.benefit: The Sister of Battle is not merely protected by her faith in the Emperor, it is clear to all that He has plans for her and she will not die until He ordains it.

talents.name: Hit and Run
talents.benefit: Seraphim are masters of battleﬁ eld mobility and ﬁ nd that rapid response is one of their greatest assets.

talents.name: Holy Hatred
talents.benefit: Celestians know that those who do not serve the Emperor with the entirety of their existence are merely heretics, mutants, or worse waiting to happen.

talents.name: Pure Faith
talents.benefit: Among the teeming billions of the faithful, a rare handful of individuals are truly touched by the God- Emperor’s divine hand.

sources.citation: Dark Heresy: Daemon Hunter (FFG, WH40K Roleplay), new Talents
sources.coverage: ok — 11 talents from Dark Heresy - Daemon Hunter.md

talents.name: Malleus Conditioning
talents.benefit: Many Inquisitors of the Ordo Malleus expend considerable effort to make sure that their agents are well protected against the Daemons of the Warp.

talents.name: Intellectualization
talents.benefit: The character is adept at rationalizing words and text and stripping them of their power over him.

talents.name: Speed Reading
talents.benefit: Through years of practice the character has developed the ability read text at an astonishing rate.

talents.name: Aura of Faith
talents.benefit: Daemonic entities reel from the Acolyte, their daemonic powers cleansed in his presence.

talents.name: Rite of Banishment
talents.benefit: This rite is closely guarded, written only in the most sacred texts and taught only to experienced Banishers.

talents.name: Cult Briefing
talents.benefit: The character has undergone indoctrination so that he may blend into a Chaos cult.

talents.name: Sicarius Tutoring
talents.benefit: Each Acolyte receives different training from their Ordo Sicarius contacts before returning to the service of the Ordo Malleus.

talents.name: Blessed Flame
talents.benefit: Specialized training in holy litanies of maintenance combined with blessed promethium allows the Acolyte to bring his ﬂ amers to bear against daemons with potent effect.

talents.name: Flames of Faith
talents.benefit: The Acolyte’s faith in both the God-Emperor of Mankind and his trusted weapon causes Psyﬂ ame ammunition to burn even brighter.

talents.name: Mechadendrite Use (techsorcist)
talents.benefit: The Techsorcist has chosen to alter one of his mechadendrites to assist in his duties.

talents.name: Emperor's Tarot
talents.benefit: Once per Game Session, the Psyker may read the portents of the Emperor's Tarot.

talents.benefit: The soul and mind of a Pilgrim of Hayte has been so damaged and consumed by bitterness and malice that there is room for little else.

talents.name: Touched by the Fates
talents.book: Dark Heresy: Disciples of the Dark Gods
talents.prerequisites: Non Player Characters only, they must have free will, and may not be applied to Daemons and other non-living creatures
talents.benefit: The NPC has a number of Fate Points equal to half his Willpower Bonus (rounding up).

talents.name: Physical Perfection
talents.benefit: Similar to the Explorator Talent The Flesh is Weak (see the ROGUE TRADER CORE RULEBOOK page 107), the Augmenticist’s body has been modiﬁed to the point where it is almost totally mechanical.

talents.name: Best of the Best
talents.benefit: The Flight Marshall is simply the ﬁnest pilot in the sky, the void, or even ﬁve meters off the ground on a dare.

talents.name: Ded Sneaky
talents.benefit: The prospect of an Ork bursting from a concealed position and attacking is an unsettling one to say the least, and the few who survive the experience never forget the sight of a hulking green-skinned monster appearing nearby with a gigantic blade in hand.

talents.name: Worky Gubbinz
talents.benefit: The Ork has an innate and instinctive skill with machinery, allowing him to perform feats of engineering that defy logic, cobbling together random lumps of wrecked technology and scrap metal into something bizarre and startlingly effective.

talents.name: Survival Master
talents.benefit: The Torchbearer’s ability to thrive in the most inhospitable and desolate areas allows him to continue his holy mission where others would fall.

talents.name: Apostate Mechanic
talents.benefit: The Explorer modifies himself with arcane technology and now wields techno-arcane powers normally the preserve of the Priesthood of Mars.

talents.name: Subversive Programming
talents.benefit: The Explorer has devised a binary argot that confuses and subverts the programming of servitors and other machine- creatures, allowing him to direct their actions.

talents.name: Luminen Desecration
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s implants generate a violent techsorcism pulse, allowing him to disable technology in his presence.

talents.name: Vile Intrusion
talents.benefit: The Explorer is skilled at gaining access to the knowledge of the most sophisticated machine spirits, assailing them with scrap-code and malicious spirits of his own creation, until they break under the strain.

talents.name: Operative Conditioning
talents.benefit: The Explorer gains the benefits of the Chem-geld and Orthoproxy talents (mental conditioning replacing the surgery these would normally require).

talents.name: Killer’s Eye
talents.prerequisites: Perception 35 and either Sure Strike or Deadeye Shot
talents.benefit: The Explorer can find the weaknesses of his prey with only a few moments of observation.

talents.name: Take Them Alive
talents.prerequisites: Perception 35 and either Sure Strike or Deadeye Shot
talents.benefit: The Explorer is well versed in laying his enemies low without killing them, able to incapacitate his targets and limit the damage he inflicts to them.

talents.name: Cold Soul
talents.benefit: The Explorer has become disconnected from normal human emotions or feelings as his sense of humanity drains away.

talents.name: Combat Flair
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s skills in melee are without parallel, but more importantly he fights with a stylish jaunty confidence guaranteed to impress even his foes.

talents.name: Reputation (seceded Worlds)
talents.benefit: These talents apply specifically to the world or worlds that the Explorer has led from the rule of the Imperium; Secessionist leaders are often loved by their people.

talents.name: Grand Oratory
talents.benefit: The Explorer’s words inspire loyalty and dissent in equal measure, and can influence hundreds of individuals at once.

talents.name: Touched by the Fates
talents.benefit: free will, may not be applied to Daemons or other non- living creatures.

talents.name: Guerilla Training
talents.benefit: Left with an incredibly low number of men after the massacre at Istvaan V, the Raven Guard had to become masters of rapid deployment, stealth, and guerilla tactics.

talents.name: Artificer
talents.benefit: The people of Nocturne and the Salamanders alike hold great respect for artisans and other skilled craftsmen, and every Battle-Brother of the Salamanders is trained to some degree in the skills of the smith.

talents.name: Born in the Saddle
talents.benefit: The White Scars are legendarily skilled at fighting whilst mounted upon bikes, their metal steeds serving more as an extension to the rider’s body than as a distinct object.

talents.name: Mental Fortitude
talents.benefit: The Ravenwing are required to possess absolute strength of character, unclouded by doubt or disloyalty and untroubled by spiritual turmoil or corruption.

talents.name: Deathwing Assault
talents.benefit: The Deathwing favour rapid teleport attacks, appearing literally from nowhere (often collaborating with Ravenwing squadrons to ensure precision) to deliver overwhelming force against an unprepared enemy.

talents.name: Patient Hunter
talents.benefit: The Battle-Brother understands well that stealth is not merely a matter of silence and shadow, but of timing and awareness, and he can elude the gaze of his enemies simply by understanding what they can see and hear, and always being where they aren’t looking.

talents.name: Sudden Attack
talents.benefit: The Battle-Brother is well-versed in the arts of surprise and disruption, and can stall large numbers of enemies with careful planning and cunning.

talents.name: Mentor
talents.benefit: The Wolf Priest has seen much and learned much, and now passes that hard-won insight to his Battle-Brothers.

talents.name: Tyrannic War Stratagem
talents.benefit: The Battle-Brother’s hard-won experience against the Tyranids has resulted in him mastering, or in some cases even devising, a variety of unusual strategies intended to combat the unique menace of the Great Devourer.

talents.name: Honour or Death
talents.benefit: The Battle-Brother is a champion of the Ultramarines and of the Adeptus Astartes as a whole, and stands defiant against the mightiest of foes.

talents.name: Ace Operator
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character is known for maintaining masterful control of his vehicle through seemingly reckless manoeuvres, often astounding others with his daring and skill.

talents.name: Ambush
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The Tactica Imperialis teaches that a battle is easily won if the enemy does not know he is fighting.

talents.name: Abiding Resilience
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Whether driven by hatred for his enemies, loyalty to his allies, or sheer pride, the character refuses to die until a job is finished.

talents.name: Creative Killer
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character sees everything as a potential weapon, and can kill while wielding with almost anything he can get his hands on.

talents.name: Cybernetic Boost
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: One or more Cybernetic Limbs, Tech-Use
talents.benefit: Cybernetics are an important part of life for many members of the Imperial Guard, for soldiers often need to replace lost or crippled limbs and organs of vulnerable flesh and blood with assuredly superior appendages and devices of metal and oil.

talents.name: Cybernetic Calibrations
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: Two or more Cybernetics, Tech-Use +10, Cybernetic Boost
talents.benefit: This character, either through initiation into the mysteries of the Omnissiah or tinkering that would certainly attract negative attention from such individuals, has fine-tuned his cybernetic implants to a point of optimization.

talents.name: Bombardier
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Due to many years of training, and an obsession that squad mates might find unnerving, the character is an expert with explosive weapons and has an uncanny control over where projectiles land.

talents.name: Calculated Barrage
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character is exceptionally good at conceptualizing the battlefield and picking just the right place to drop vast amounts of explosives to maximum effect—not just on the enemies bodies, but also on their morale.

talents.name: Chain Weapon Expertise
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: From the chainswords wielded by officers and other leadership figures to the eviscerators favoured by the priests of the Adeptus Ministorum, chain weapons are a common sight amongst the armouries of the Imperial Guard.

talents.name: Cleanse and Purify
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character is a firm believer in the purifying power of fire—that the heretic, xenos, and witch must be incinerated lest their corruption spread.

talents.name: Duelist
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Thanks to extensive practice in ritualised duels, years of fighting in impromptu rings, or other specific training, this character is particularly skilled at engaging single opponents on his own.

talents.name: Excellent Cook
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Though the clerks of the Departmento Munitorum seemingly refuse to recognise the fact, a good meal can provide a great boost to morale for weary troops.

talents.name: Feat of Strength
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character’s prodigious strength has seen them through numerous encounters.

talents.name: Death Serves the Righteous
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character is a consummate killer, with focus such that time seems to slow down when he holds a target in his sights and the battlefield fades away except for his target.

talents.name: Drop Trooper
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character is a veteran of many low altitude combat drops, accomplishing the death-defying feat almost by rote.

talents.name: Guardian
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Some guardsmen develop an almost fanatical sense of loyalty to their officers or squad mates, and are even willing to trade their own lives to protect others.

talents.name: Heroic Inspiration
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character is exceptionally skilled at knowing just what to say to bring out the best in his squad mates and keep them on task in the worst of situations, though whether this is through wise words, fiery rhetoric, or mild provocation depends on the individual and the situation.

talents.name: Final Judgement
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: Fellowship 45, Air of Authority, Deadeye Shot
talents.benefit: Discipline within the Imperial Guard is harsh and, often, terminal.

talents.name: Melta Weapon Expertise
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Meltaguns are extremely powerful and dangerous weapons, but also frequently require the firer to draw dangerously close to his target to use the weapon at full effectiveness.

talents.name: Melta Weapon Mastery
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: When engaging vehicles or war engines of flesh and blood, Imperial Guardsmen look to special weapons such as the meltagun to bring down these behemoths that their lasguns cannot fell.

talents.name: Mental Maze
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Through a harsh mental regimen, this character has developed a system of mental defence against mental intrusion that puts not only his strength of will but also his cunning to work, trapping his foe in a disorienting cage of memory and thought.

talents.name: Methodical Care
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character does his utmost to make sure that his comrades do not die on the operating table.

talents.name: Lasgun Volley
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character has trained extensively with his trusty lasgun, including endless drills with his fellow soldiers, ensuring that their shots are perfectly timed to inflict maximum damage upon the enemy.

talents.name: Las Weapon Expertise
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Though all Guardsmen are expected to be proficient with their main weapon and for most this is the noble lasgun, some troopers exceed these baseline expectations and become incredible shots with their lasguns, turning them into the instruments of death that the Emperor most assuredly intended them to be.

talents.name: Las Weapon Mastery
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character’s time spent training with las weapons is perhaps only exceeded by his time spent using them to kill the enemies of the God-Emperor in the fields of war.

talents.name: Lock On
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character is known for a steely, unflinching gaze and an uncanny ability to hold a target in his sights even as he calmly sidesteps attacks, casually sliding the minimum distance required to evade a fatal blow without blinking.

talents.name: Overkill
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character has spent enough time fighting the enemies of the Imperium to know that some creatures do not die when all sense says that they should expire, and that it is better to be safe than sorry when dealing with the unknown.

talents.name: Persuasive Charm
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Those individuals tasked with distributing supplies amongst the regiments of the Imperial Guard are notoriously taciturn when faced with requests for additional equipment, harried as they are by countless requests from countless soldiers, many of which are simply not within their power to fulfil.

talents.name: Plasma Weapon Expertise
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Plasma guns are incredibly lethal weapons, but are also somewhat notorious for getting their wielders killed.

talents.name: Modify Payload
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: In many squads, there is one soldier who is always tinkering with the sacred munitions handed down by the Departmento Munitorum, tweaking their specifications so that they are as lethal to the enemies of the Emperor as possible.

talents.name: Righteous Blow
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: Ballistic Skill 45 or Weapon Skill 45 or Willpower 45
talents.benefit: The character is an instrument of divine wrath, bringing the Emperor’s judgment to the enemies of Mankind.

talents.name: Plasma Weapon Mastery
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character has not only learned to minimise the risk to himself with a plasma gun, but has become exceptionally adept at directing its lethal fury while firing it on its optimal setting.

talents.name: Pugilist
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: When facing down the terrible foes of the Imperium, most soldiers prefer to be standing behind the largest guns available.

talents.name: Push the Limit
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character has devised a method for operating the controls of a vehicles that falls somewhat outside the standards of operation meticulously set forth in the doctrinal manuals of the Departmento Munitorum, to say nothing of the august tech-rites of the Enginseers responsible for maintaining the

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Expert
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Though capable with a variety of ranged weapons, the character has honed his training to become particularly lethal with a certain, specific kind of arm.

talents.name: Solid Projectile Weapon Expertise
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Ballistic Skill 35, Weapon Training

talents.name: Solid Projectile Weapon Mastery
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: Ballistic Skill 45, Solid Projectile Weapon Expertise
talents.benefit: Some troopers hone their skills with solid projectile weapons despite their apparently primitive construction, becoming as well-versed in their use as their most adept lasgun-wielding counterparts are with their own firearms.

talents.name: Stealth Sniper
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character knows the value of staying hidden even after battle has been joined, and has learned to time his shots so that he is extremely difficult to pinpoint, even after opening fire into a group of foes.

talents.name: Rite of Static Overload
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: One or more Cybernetic limbs, Tech-Use +10
talents.benefit: Cybernetic limbs and mechadendrites are typically designed to be insulated against any loss of control over the energies within, thus protecting their users from the risks associated with powerful electric currents running through the body.

talents.name: Sacred Flame
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Fire is a strong metaphor for piety to the God-Emperor of Mankind; it sears away all impurities, leaving only that which was ordained to survive.

talents.name: Skilled Rider
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character is an accomplished rider, as home in the saddle as on his own two feet.

talents.name: Tireless
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Through brute force of will or extreme physical resilience, this character is capable of carrying on through extreme adversity and exhaustion without losing significant efficiency.

talents.name: Trademark Item
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character possesses a certain item for which he is well known, such as a decorative cap, a pipe, or even a particular weapon.

talents.name: Stirring Rhetoric
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character can make a direct and personal appeal to the squad to strive on, not merely ordering them to fight but calling upon the shared bonds of camaraderie that soldiers share and truly inspiring them.

talents.name: Swift Suture
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character knows the deleterious effects of letting blood seep from an injury too long, even a small one, and deftly sews shut any open gashes in and around working to wrap burns, treat toxins, or set bones.

talents.name: Tank Hunter
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character has faced enemy war machines on numerous occasions, whether the corrupted battle tanks of rebels and traitors or the strange grav vehicles of the xenos.

talents.name: Vigilant
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character has a keen eye, and can hold details in his vision without losing sight of the whole picture, even in tense situations.

talents.name: Wrestler
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: The character is a practiced grappler, adept at wrestling his foes to the ground and keeping them there.

talents.name: Unstoppable Charge
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: Experienced Rough Riders are true masters of mounted warfare, often able to end a battle with a single, decisive charge.

talents.name: Versatile Shooter
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.benefit: This character has honed his ability with single-shot weapons to the point that he can fire almost any precision weapon nearly as accurately as a rifle.

talents.name: Veteran Comrade
talents.book: Only War: Hammer of the Emperor
talents.prerequisites: Character Speciality that includes a Comrade
talents.benefit: This character’s Comrade is particularly experienced or otherwise talented, and fights at a level above the average soldier in the regiment.

talents.name: Addictrix
talents.benefit: The Heretic is a master of seduction and manipulation, and has ways of securing power over those who succumb to his wiles.

talents.name: Beloved Leader
talents.benefit: Whether due to brainwashing, charisma, hypno-doctrination, or even a blessing from Slaanesh himself, this Heretic’s Minions are devoutly loyal.

talents.name: Horde Minion of Chaos
talents.benefit: Through various means, the character has acquired a veritable Horde of servants.

talents.name: Lord of Chaos
talents.benefit: Through dint of his fearsome reputation, prophesied destiny, or even a daemonic pact, the character can attract—and keep—a considerably larger retinue than his peers.

talents.name: Minion Improvement
talents.benefit: The Heretic’s Superior Minion gains 500 xp to spend on Advancements, as detailed on page 50.

talents.name: Superior Minion of Chaos
talents.benefit: Through various means, the character has acquired a Superior Minion.

talents.name: Tyrant
talents.prerequisites: Any Minion of Chaos Talent, Fellowship 35
talents.benefit: The Heretic ensures Loyalty through a fearful reputation and the actions to back it up.

talents.name: Air of Authority
talents.benefit: The character was born to command; bystanders and opponents cannot help but take note of what he is saying.

talents.name: Cold Hearted
talents.benefit: The character is devoid of sentiment and is seldom swayed by the emotions of others.

talents.name: Dark Oratory
talents.benefit: The character is a natural rabble-rouser with a talent for enthralling and swaying crowds to his cause.

talents.name: Demagogue
talents.benefit: The character can influence large audiences.

talents.name: Disturbing Voice
talents.benefit: The character’s voice has a particularly baleful quality.

talents.name: Eloquent
talents.benefit: The character has a flair for words and language, able to sway and bamboozle an opponent in a riot of syntax.

talents.name: Implied Threat
talents.benefit: The character is adroit at loading seemingly innocuous phrases with threats, dark promises, or insults.

talents.name: Inspire Wrath
talents.benefit: The character can inspire hatred in others.

talents.name: Mimic
talents.benefit: The character is a gifted impersonator.

talents.name: Nerves of Steel
talents.benefit: The character remains calm and impervious to intimidating behaviour.

talents.name: Peer
talents.benefit: The character has specialist knowledge when it comes to a certain group or organisation.

talents.name: Pity the Weak
talents.benefit: The character despises those weaker than him.

talents.name: Polygot
talents.benefit: The character has an innate ability with unknown languages.

talents.name: Unremarkable
talents.benefit: The character’s face does not stick in people’s memories, and few would consider conversation, let alone verbal sparring, with such a bland countenance.
